scope: CPU-only exact-input reconstruction and source-transcribed FP32 EE trace; no GPU dispatch and no production edits

native_observation.diagnostic_decoding: source106 EE failure writes [candidate.x,candidate.y,edgeA,edgeB]; this is primitive pair 24/127, edgeA=1, edgeB=0. The source106 generic VT failure marker stores diagnostic.w=3+direction. Pair incidence ranges are empty, so the mortar complement path is not entered.

lineage.geometry_basis: source106 N7 trial positions/velocities are reconstructed from its center nodes, accepted state, correction, and recorded Armijo alpha using nm_fem_apply_solution semantics. Source103 trial358 is only a cross-build geometry comparison; node position/velocity ULP distances are reported and device fingerprints differ. The edgeEdgeCCD bodies match byte-for-byte.

independent_fp64_geometric_minimum.method: FP64 promoted captured FP32 endpoints; dense sampling plus local golden-section refinement; not a formal CCD certificate

interpretation.failure_type: source106 native N7 last-trial generic EE call returned uncertified; the status is not proof of physical interpenetration
interpretation.vt_hypothesis: ruled out for diagnostic [24,127,1,0]; separate VT replay is an unrelated certified miss
interpretation.mortar_hypothesis: ruled out for pair24/127: both incidence ranges have count zero
interpretation.16_17_33: 17 is the source106 production edgeEdgeCCD loop bound; 16 is a comparison cap; 33 is diagnostic extension only. The CPU transcription hits on call 17 while native source106 returns uncertified, so this does not establish that a larger production bound would resolve the native case.
interpretation.cross_build_status: source103 trial358 uses the same accepted state and correction and its reconstructed geometry is within one position ULP of source106, but its recorded failure is a different pair (92/127, edge0/edge0). It is not the source106 native failure.
interpretation.precision: CPU FP32 transcription follows source expression ordering but is not bitwise Metal evidence. The hit-vs-uncertified margin is only about 0.05–0.06 nm; the independent FP64 minimum lies within the effective thickness band but is not a formal production CCD certificate.

limitations: No GPU execution or native replay in this package.

Trial358 binary was source103; source106 371 supplies the authoritative N7 status, pair, and line-search alpha. Its candidate geometry is reconstructed from source106 arrays and cross-checked against the source103 candidate without claiming that the source103 device capture is source106.
A later 33-iteration CPU extension cannot qualify a larger production bound.
The FP64 geometric minimum does not prove continuous separation under the production rounding/certificate rules.
